name: apple
description: Apple ecosystem integration: Notes, Reminders, Find My, and iMessage — all in one macOS-only suite.

interface.shortDescription: Apple ecosystem integration for Notes, Reminders, Find My, and iMessage on macOS.
interface.longDescription: Apple ecosystem integration for Notes, Reminders, Find My, and iMessage on macOS. All four capabilities are bundled under one plugin, each accessible as a standalone skill. Requires macOS with the respective Apple apps signed into iCloud.
defaultPrompt: Create a note in Apple Notes

skills.name: apple-notes
skills.description: Manage Apple Notes via the memo CLI on macOS (create, view, search, edit).

skills.name: apple-reminders
skills.description: Manage Apple Reminders via remindctl CLI (list, add, complete, delete).

skills.name: findmy
skills.description: Track Apple devices and AirTags via FindMy.app on macOS using AppleScript and screen capture.

skills.name: imessage
skills.description: Send and receive iMessages/SMS via the imsg CLI on macOS.
